---
title: "The Bond Films"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")
```

The Bond films run from `{python} int(bond["year"].min())` to `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.

```{python}
#| label: fig-bond
#| fig-cap: "Revenue of the Bond films over time"

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million US$)")
plt.show()
```
